summary: Iteration 18: tested subscribers bulk-email feature + extended Home editable settings (Meet Erica / Stats / Newsletter). Backend 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend end-to-end passed: admin login, new Subscribers tab with count + CSV download (filename=beacons-subscribers.csv, rows marked EXPORTED after download), all 13 new Settings data-testids present (meet/stat 1-3/newsletter), Meet Erica title edit reflects on Home, regression check confirmed hero-save does NOT clear the new Meet Erica field (putAll merge working), and public Home newsletter form now persists via POST /api/subscribers with 'Subscribed!' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: Email validation on POST /api/subscribers is very loose (only checks for '@' and '.') — consider EmailStr from pydantic for stronger validation.
Admin.jsx is ~2200+ lines. Consider splitting SubscribersPanel and the growing SettingsPanel into separate files for maintainability (file-size guideline >700 lines).

GET /api/subscribers/export.csv side-effects (mark_exported=true default) on a GET request — semantically GET should be idempotent. Consider POST /api/subscribers/export or making mark_exported=false the default and requiring explicit opt-in.
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned up TEST_iter18@example.com. Additional test_ui_<ts>@example.com entries left in DB from UI newsletter test (harmless, prefixed with test_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscribers + extended Home settings fully working. Backend endpoints: POST /api/subscribers (public, dedupe, 400 on bad email), GET /api/subscribers (admin), GET /api/subscribers/export.csv (admin, marks exported), DELETE /api/subscribers/{id} (admin). SiteSettings extended with home_meet_title/body, home_stat_{1,2,3}_value/label, home_newsletter_title/body — all merge safely on PUT /api/settings. Admin.jsx: Subscribers tab between reviews and resources; SettingsPanel has 3 new blocks with data-testids meet-*, stat-{1,2,3}-{value,label}-input + stats-save, newsletter-*.
